svg.aria-label: Week 3, The workforce of the future. Workers — a solar installer in a hard hat, an engineer with a tablet and a technician carrying a solar panel — walk across a golden skills bridge from an old smoky factory to a green city with wind turbines, solar roofs, trees and an electric train. Below, four students talk around a table under four circles: O, F, N, R — observe, feel, need, request.
svg.title: Week 3 Day 1: green jobs and good teams
